title: fanoutqa: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old? (cc4e6774f97b0101)

chat_history.content: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?

content.content:
The user asks: "Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?" Need to list heads of state (presidents/monarchs) of founding EU countries (the six founding members: Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, West Germany (now Germany)). Also possibly founding EU earlier? The EU founding treaties: 1951 European Coal and Steel Community (six members) then 1957 Treaty of Rome (same six). So we need heads of state of those six countries, as of now (2025). Determine which heads of state are older than 80 years old.

Need current heads of state (not government). For each country:

- Belgium: King Philippe (born 15 April 1960) age 65, not >80.

- France: President Emmanuel Macron (born 21 Dec 1977) age 47, not >80. Also there is a President of the Republic as head of state. So no.

- Italy: President Sergio Mattarella (born 23 July 1941) age 84 (as of 2025). He turned 84 in 2025. So >80.

- Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri (born 16 April 1955) age 70, not >80.

- Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander (born 27 April 1967) age 58, not >80.

- Germany: President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (born 5 Jan 1956) age 69, not >80. However Germany also has Chancellor as head of government, not needed.

Thus only Italy's President Mattarella is older than 80. Also maybe other founding countries have former heads? But question likely asks current heads.

Check if any other head of state older than 80: maybe Belgium also has a regent? No.

Thus answer: Sergio Mattarella (Italy) is >80.

Provide ages.

Will double-check dates using function to compute ages? Could compute quickly.

Let's compute age as of today 2025-10-30.

- Mattarella born 1941-07-23. Age: 2025-10-30 minus 1941-07-23 = 84 years 3 months 7 days.

Thus >80.

Provide answer accordingly.

content:
**Founding members of the EU (the six countries that signed the 1957 Treaty of Rome)**  

| Country | Head of State (2025) | Date of Birth | Age on 30 Oct 2025 | Over 80? |
|---------|----------------------|---------------|-------------------|----------|
| Belgium | King Philippe | 15 Apr 1960 | 65 y 6 m 15 d | No |
| France | President Emmanuel Macron | 21 Dec 1977 | 47 y 10 m 9 d | No |
| Italy | President **Sergio Mattarella** | 23 Jul 1941 | **84 y 3 m 7 d** | **Yes** |
| Luxembourg | Grand‑Duke Henri | 16 Apr 1955 | 70 y 6 m 14 d | No |
| Netherlands | King Willem‑Alexander | 27 Apr 1967 | 58 y 6 m 3 d | No |
| Germany | President Frank‑Walter Steinmeier | 5 Jan 1956 | 69 y 9 m 25 d | No |

### Answer
Among the heads of state of the EU’s six founding countries, **only Italy’s President Sergio Mattarella is older than 80 years** (he is 84 years old as of 30 October 2025). All the other current heads of state are under 80.
